classification_legend.demonstrated: Concept renders a full region/manager for this family with representative deep flows and all critical states.
classification_legend.shared_grammar: Family is owned by a sibling concept; Atlas reaches it via the shared setting-row grammar, ManagerShell, ResourceList, and minimap navigation so it is not missing.
classification_legend.deferred_named_owner: Family is a future module; named canonical owner + insertion contract provided. Never 'missing'.
classification_legend.missing: FAIL — not used by this concept. The rule forbids missing.

coverage_rule: Every family across the matrix is classified demonstrated, shared_grammar, or deferred_named_owner. Atlas demonstrates its C2-owned families + the required core surface; sibling-owned families are reachable through shared grammar; the future Server module is deferred to its named owner.

families.demo_note: Atlas Home is the atlas overview: destinations as bounded regions on a 12-column grid sized by content density; a right rail holds legend + notices + theme; a you-are-here marker tracks the current region. Home's four jobs (search, enter destination, attention notices, resume recent) are all present.

Cmd+K command overlay centered at the top of the atlas; focusing dims the map and surfaces typed results (scalar setting, manager destination, one-shot action, read-only status, diagnostic, setup workflow, unavailable capability); selecting flies the viewport to the region/section. Fuzzy multi-token, deep-linkable. Typo fixture exercised.

Focus + context: the chosen region fills the canvas as a continuous document of its subcategories; a compact minimap rail keeps every region visible (current highlighted); a viewport rail shows the in-view subcategory with a scroll-position thumb. Scrolling updates the minimap; clicking a subcategory performs a controlled jump.

Full object model (Provider family → Account/Profile → Connection → Product/Entitlement → Models/capabilities; Host/Environment → Installation). Connection groups: installed apps, connected accounts, API, server, free-community. Demonstrates 7 installation lifecycle fixtures (confidence + update states), CLI-owned vs PM-direct OAuth boundary, requested/effective routes, Free Models setup, catalog freshness. Provider region is never a flat list.

SettingRow grammar across all regions: title, concise explanation, current value/state, default or source, scope, availability, restart/reconnect requirement, help/details, validation/error. Nine explicit value states rendered via ValueSourceBadge. Exposure levels Standard/Advanced/Expert/Managed/Diagnostic/Unavailable. Search finds all levels.

8-destination router (in-app title-bar stack [SOLE in-app surface], system/tray, Slack, Discord, generic webhook, ntfy, Pushover, Telegram) with event routing, per-event sound mappings, quiet/focus. Test-send masked + rate-limited + receipted. Title-bar stack is the only in-app notification affordance — no bottom-right stack, status-bar bell, Activity Bar shortcut, or dedicated side panel.

Built-in + uploaded sounds with source/license/version/duration/hash metadata; PeonPing/OpenPeon-compatible pack import with format + license checks (unverified packs never bundled); local-only preview; master volume; import/export; delete/replace. ResourceList manager with HealthSummary showing verification state.

Beyond 8 themes: 4 families (Friendly/Glass/Retro/Basic) × Light/Dark/Auto, OS-following (prefers-color-scheme live), custom TOML with schema validation + invalid-with-fallback, base-theme inheritance, startup load + live reload, custom + fallback fonts, UI scale, restart markers, create/import/export/open-folder, live hover preview, theme-specific locked/unavailable rows.

Dictionary sources Automatic (OS service then PM local)/system-only/PM-local-only; personal + project dictionaries as separate scopes; technical-prose toggle; underline-unknown-names; language packs; thread/project overrides. NO autocorrect. Grammar/style is a separate opt-in provider-backed feature with privacy/route/cost/Usage disclosure (deferred engine, demonstrated gate).

Minimize-to-tray, tray-while-automation badge, Pause/Resume/Quit, launch destination, window/panel/tab restore, crash recovery, unsaved-buffer protection, activity-bar reorder/hide/overflow, side-panel restore, editor/tab/tree limits. App-level tray controls kept distinct from run-scoped orchestrator pause/resume.

Explicit Teacher assistance beyond tooltips: explain-current-screen, guided transitions into real actions, tooltip detail at hover and keyboard focus. Teacher can explain the Notifications region and transition safely into opening a destination.

families.named_canonical_owner: concept_04 (Storage/Recovery/Server-first topology) + Plans server-first topology owner (Servers / Execution Hosts / Clients / Project Hosting & Files / Remote Access / Updates)
families.insertion_contract: Atlas reserves a System region slot and exposes the shared ManagerShell + ResourceList/Card/Detail + HealthSummary grammar + route/open deep-link target so a future Server module can drop in as a region without re-architecting the atlas. No server backend state machine, Project Sync, or app-update state machine is invented here. The insertion point is a stable region id + a cmd.settings.manager.open-shaped wrapper.
